I also have an occasional dry cough, but I don’t have fever, chills, or night sweats.

turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any sudden or urgent need to urinate, and I don’t have symptoms like that. My main issue has been the gradually worsening shortness of breath with activity and an occasional dry cough.

turns.patient_answer: No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or masses in any breast tissue. My symptoms have been limited to the progressively worsening shortness of breath with activity and an occasional dry, non-productive cough.
